description: This file provides an implementation of a package management service for an agent system. It includes functions for installing, uninstalling, and listing packages, with support for handling local directories, Git URLs, dependencies, environment variables, and registry updates. It encapsulates logic for validation, copying files, managing dependencies, and maintaining an installation registry.

classes.name: DefaultPackageService
classes.description: Implements package management functionalities including installation, uninstallation, listing, and dependency handling for the agent system.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: A CLI spinner for indicating progress during long-running operations.

methods.name: InstallPackage
methods.description: Installs a package from either a Git URL or local directory based on the source string.

methods.name: installLocalPackage
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a local package directory, including validation, copying, dependency installation, and registry update.

methods.name: UninstallPackage
methods.description: Removes an installed package, stopping running instances if necessary.

methods.name: uninstallPackage
methods.description: Performs the actual uninstallation steps, including stopping processes, deleting files, and updating the registry.

methods.name: stopAgentNode
methods.description: Stops a running agent node process by PID.

methods.name: saveRegistry
methods.description: Persists the current registry state to disk.

methods.name: ListInstalledPackages
methods.description: Returns a list of all installed packages.

methods.name: GetPackageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific installed package.

methods.name: loadRegistryDirect
methods.description: Loads the registry file directly from disk.

methods.name: convertToDomainPackage
methods.description: Converts a registry-specific package representation to the domain model.

methods.name: validatePackage
methods.description: Validates expected package structure and files.

methods.name: parsePackageMetadata
methods.description: Reads and parses package metadata from agentfield-package.yaml.

methods.name: isPackageInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the package is already installed.

methods.name: copyPackage
methods.description: Copies package files from source directory to target directory.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies a single file from source path to destination.

methods.name: installDependencies
methods.description: Installs Python and system dependencies specified in metadata.

methods.name: hasRequirementsFile
methods.description: Checks for presence of requirements.txt file.

methods.name: updateRegistry
methods.description: Adds or updates package entry in the installation registry.

methods.name: checkEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Verifies required environment variables and provides setup guidance.

methods.name: newSpinner
methods.description: Creates a CLI spinner instance for displaying progress.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the spinner animation.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the spinner animation.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Stops spinner and displays a success message.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Stops spinner and displays an error message.
